styleStudio.title: Common styles · local preview
styleStudio.description: Preview changes in the showcase below. Only Apply to file saves them. Portal dialogs outside the showcase are not included in this preview.
styleStudio.colorHelp: Use #RRGGBB or rgba(r, g, b, alpha). Light and dark values are independent.
styleStudio.lengthHelp: Lengths use rem; 1rem is the browser root font size. Shared values affect both themes. Component-specific typography overrides remain.
styleStudio.saved: Saved. CSS changes apply through HMR; the previous file was backed up.

errors.conflict: The file changed outside this preview. Reload it before applying; your draft has been kept.
errors.invalid_input: Check colors, units and allowed ranges. Nothing was saved.
errors.unsupported_styles: This stylesheet no longer matches the supported common token format.
errors.forbidden: Local editing is unavailable. Open the loopback development server again.
errors.unsafe_path: The stylesheet or backup directory has an unsupported linked path.
errors.io_error: Could not access the local stylesheet. Check the server and file permissions.
